evals.prompt: Design a 2-bedroom resilient coastal hillside residence on a 60ft x 100ft lot with 15ft front and rear setbacks and 10ft side setbacks. Ensure CMU modular 16" grid alignment, an inverted living program, a spatial UX circulation map, and a resilience utility core.
evals.expected_output: Buildable CMU floorplan with modular dimension validation, Mermaid circulation topology, 2D CAD SVG plan, and architectural schedule.
assertions: Exterior dimensions snap to 8-inch or 16-inch CMU increments
Setbacks are fully respected in the buildable envelope
A Mermaid circulation graph is generated with clear hierarchy
Arterial corridors have at least 42-48 inches of clear width
SVG output includes structural grid, walls, door swings, and North arrow
Resilience utility core with cistern and battery storage is incorporated

evals.prompt: Audit and redesign a proposed floorplan where the master bedroom shares an uninsulated wall with a solar inverter and booster pump room, and the front door looks directly into a guest bathroom toilet.
evals.expected_output: Spatial UX audit identifying the acoustic and sightline defects, followed by a redesigned circulation layout with acoustic buffering and visual baffles.
assertions: Identifies acoustic conflict between master bedroom and mechanical room
Identifies visual privacy breach into bathroom
Proposes acoustic buffer wall, closet chase, or layout separation
Introduces privacy vestibule or 90-degree visual baffle
